ja: 内部構造まで再現しながらも簡単に組み合てられるハロプラから、黒い三連星仕様のハロがクリアカラーになって登場！
• 耳は開閉し、手足は差し替えで再現！
• 他のハロプラやプチッガイとの連結が可能！
• 余剰パーツは台座に収納可能！
• ３機分のナンバーを再現できるホイルシールが付属！
en: From halopla, which can be easily combined while reproducing the internal structure, a halo with a black triple star specification is now available in clear color!
• The ears are opened and closed, and the limbs are reproduced by replacement!
• Can be connected with other haloplas and petit guys!
• Surplus parts can be stored on the pedestal!
• Comes with a foil seal that can reproduce the numbers of 3 aircraft!
